# Notes: RGS (Remote Gaming Server) API

<!-- Generated by Copilot -->
_Source: https://stake-engine.com/docs/rgs and https://stake-engine.com/docs/rgs/wallet_
_Markdown mirror: https://github.com/jovanpanetie/stake-engine-md-doc/blob/main/rgs.md_

---

## Summary

The RGS (Carrot Remote Gaming Server) is the backend that sits between your game and Stake. Your frontend talks to it via HTTP API calls. You never interact with Stake.com directly — only through the RGS.

---

## Core API Flow

```
Game loads
  → POST /wallet/authenticate   (validates sessionID, returns player balance + config)
  
Player places bet
  → POST /wallet/play           (debits player, returns pre-simulated outcome)
  
Animate the result
  → POST /wallet/end-round      (closes the round, credits winnings)
```

All three must be called in order every round. Skipping `/end-round` will leave a round open.

There is also a standalone balance poll:
```
POST /wallet/balance   (optional, for periodic balance refreshes)
```

---

## Game URL Structure

Games are hosted at:
```
https://{{TeamName}}.cdn.stake-engine.com/{{GameID}}/{{GameVersion}}/index.html
?sessionID=...&lang=...&device=...&rgs_url=...
```

**Parse all four params on load.** `rgs_url` must not be hardcoded — it can change.

---

## Key API Details

### `/wallet/authenticate`
- Called once on game load
- Returns: player balance, `minBet`, `maxBet`, `stepBet`, `defaultBetLevel`, `betLevels`, `jurisdiction` flags, and active `round` state
- If not called first, all other endpoints return `ERR_IS`
- **Round resumption:** if `round` in the response is still active (player disconnected mid-round), the frontend must resume it — do not start a new bet
- **Jurisdiction flags** returned in `config.jurisdiction`:
  - `socialCasino: true/false` — whether Stake.us social mode is active
  - `disabledFullscreen: true/false`
  - `disabledTurbo: true/false`

Full authenticate response shape:
```json
{
  "balance": { "amount": 1000000, "currency": "USD" },
  "config": {
    "minBet": 100000,
    "maxBet": 1000000000,
    "stepBet": 100000,
    "defaultBetLevel": 1000000,
    "betLevels": [...],
    "jurisdiction": {
      "socialCasino": false,
      "disabledFullscreen": false,
      "disabledTurbo": false
    }
  },
  "round": { ... }
}
```

### `/wallet/play`
- Player debit = `betAmount × betMode.costMultiplier`
- Returns: updated balance + `round` object (contains the pre-simulated outcome events)

### `/wallet/end-round`
- Must be called after all animations complete — even on a loss (zero payout)
- Some bonus modes set `auto_close_disabled=True` in math config — in this case the frontend must call end-round manually, not rely on auto-close
- Closes the round and applies winnings

### Bet Replay endpoint (no auth required)
```
GET {rgs_url}/bet/replay/{game}/{version}/{mode}/{event}
Returns: { payoutMultiplier, costMultiplier, state }
```

---

## Money Format

All amounts are integers with **6 decimal places**:

| Value | Integer |
|-------|---------|
| $0.01 | 10,000 |
| $0.10 | 100,000 |
| $1.00 | 1,000,000 |
| $10.00 | 10,000,000 |
| $1000.00 | 1,000,000,000 |

Currency only affects display — game logic is always currency-agnostic.

---

## Bet Levels

- Must include small bets: `$0.01, $0.02, $0.05, $0.10, ...`
- Bet must be between `minBet` and `maxBet`
- Bet must be divisible by `stepBet`
- Use the `betLevels` array from `/wallet/authenticate` to populate the UI

---

## Error Codes

| Code | Meaning | How to handle |
|------|---------|---------------|
| ERR_IS | Invalid/expired session | Show session expired message, prompt reload |
| ERR_IPB | Insufficient balance | Disable spin button, show balance warning |
| ERR_GLE | Gambling limits exceeded | Inform player, disable betting |
| ERR_LOC | Invalid player location | Show geo-restriction message |
| ERR_VAL | Invalid request | Log and debug — likely a bad param |
| ERR_GEN | Server error | Show generic error, allow retry |
| ERR_MAINTENANCE | RGS maintenance | Show maintenance message |

---

## Languages Supported

Pass as ISO 639-1 `lang` URL param:
`ar, de, en, es, fi, fr, hi, id, ja, ko, pl, pt, ru, tr, vi, zh, da`

---

## XSS Policy — Important

Stake Engine enforces a **strict XSS/CSP policy**:
- The game build must consist of **static files only**
- The game **cannot reach external URLs** — no Google Fonts, no CDN-hosted libraries, no external API calls
- All images, fonts, and assets must be loaded from the **Stake Engine CDN**
- Common failure: downloading fonts from Google Fonts logs console errors and will fail review

## Language Requirements

- **English is the only required language**
- If only English is supported, on-screen text must **not corrupt** when other `lang` params are passed (just gracefully fall back)
- Full list of supported lang codes: `ar, de, en, es, fi, fr, hi, id, ja, ko, pl, pt, ru, tr, vi, zh, da`

## Getting Started — Fifty-Fifty Example

The docs include a minimal `fifty-fifty` example game in the math SDK (`math-sdk/games/fifty_fifty/`) — 50% chance of 2x, 50% loss. Useful for:
- Testing RGS connection end-to-end before building a real game
- Understanding the full flow: math → upload → frontend → play
- The simple frontend uses Svelte 5 + Vite (not the full SDK) — good first test

## NPM Client

Stake Engine provides a TypeScript client that wraps the API:
- Repo: https://github.com/StakeEngine/ts-client
- Use this in the SDK stack — reduces boilerplate
- If using the hybrid stack, implement the wrapper manually (see `resources/stack-hybrid.md`)
